name: Agendamento - dados e lista de serviços
description: Visitante acessa a página de agendamento, preenche os dados e chega na seleção de serviços

planSteps.description: Verify the page shows the booking form with fields for phone/WhatsApp and name, and a 'Continuar' button
Fill '(11) 91234-5678' in the phone/WhatsApp input field
Fill 'Visitante Teste' in the name input field
Verify the next step shows a list of selectable services with names and prices
Select one of the available service cards
Verify the selected service becomes highlighted/marked and the price is reflected
